authority.entryRule: previous stage complete or parallel-safe documented

scope: Touch dragging and snapping the existing mobile country sheet using its existing collapsed/half/expanded state; preserve tap, keyboard, independent content scroll and the same canonical globe.
parallelSafety: The canonical globe, platform adapters and sheet reducer already exist in the current working implementation; this does not accept their stages.
Only application presentation and its touch handlers change. Paid-web authority, child policy, factual catalogues and public source projection are outside this slice.
No changes to Canvas/renderer ownership, native listeners, store automation or first-open progression.
Current routed21/22/23 govern interaction, accessibility and frame work; no documents from later route groups are loaded.
acceptanceForSlice: Actual narrow touch drag/snap and cancellation
Writer-content scroll does not become a drag gesture
Reduced motion and viewport change release gesture capture safely
